content.summary: 'Division' develops mathematical reasoning and application through the chapter 'Division'. The main learning is organised around the source-supported points below.
key_points: Write two division facts using the given multiplication fact.
35 ÷ 7 = 5 35 split into 7 groups has 5 in each group.
5 × 7 = 35 35 ÷ 5 = 7 35 split into 5 groups has 7 in each group.
